_note: Weight of the talent effects on the view (src/vfx/talent_fx.gd take_feel), by importance: per tier the crypt's shake trauma (0..1, src/vfx/feedback.gd), the story worlds' shake in px (hell_game state.shake), a hold of the picture (hitstop, s) for the hero's own casts only, and a bloom flash in the element's colour (flash s, flash_r art cells). Events pick a tier; an ultimate's cast and its waves weigh most, each bought stage a bit more (stage_bonus). Client-side pools of the ultimates (pools): material, radius as a share of the hit radius (or art cells), length in s (0 = as long as the ultimate's buff). aura_glow: bloom strength of a lasting buff on the hero. Game feel review 2026-10-30 (production/qa/evidence/talent-vfx-review).

dome._note: The shields as a rubber dome over the hero (src/vfx/talent_dome.gd). sizes: [W base half width, D base half depth, H height over the feet] in art cells for a guard flash, a shield (Kristallschild, Schutzwall, Wächtereid) and Unbezwingbar; the hero is about 16 x 28 cells. spring pulls each outline point back (1/s^2), damping slows it (1/s; low = wobbly), tension ties neighbours so a dent runs round as a wave, keep_volume (1/s) pushes the rest out when one side dents, push = a blow's speed into the dome (cells/s at power 1), max_dent a share of W, squash_* the whole dome's squash and spring back. User request 2026-10-30: a rubber dome that gives on the side an arrow hits and springs back.
